title: Beyond the Hype: Practical AI for Modern Agronomy
blurb: A technical yet accessible session on plant phenotyping, variable-rate fertilisation, and the practical data ethics of the modern autonomous orchard.
takeaway: What plant phenotyping, variable-rate fertilisation and data ethics look like in a working, increasingly autonomous orchard.

title: Eyes of the Machine: Computer Vision in Post-Harvest Quality
blurb: A deep dive into automating quality control for agrifood produce. How non-destructive AI sensing ensures shelf-life, reduces waste, and standardises global trade.
takeaway: How non-destructive AI sensing protects shelf-life, reduces waste and standardises trade.
bestFor: Packers, fresh-produce businesses, quality and supply-chain teams

title: Invisible Barriers: The Female Founder’s Journey in AgTech
blurb: An empowering narrative on navigating the male-dominated intersection of Ag & Tech, and why diversity is a prerequisite for agricultural innovation.
takeaway: Why diversity is a prerequisite for agricultural innovation, not a nice-to-have.

title: The Silicon Soil: AI’s Role in Global Food Security
blurb: A high-level keynote for policy makers and investors on how AI is moving from laboratory experiments to essential global field infrastructure.
takeaway: How AI is moving from laboratory experiments to essential field infrastructure.

title: The First Leaf: AI & Computer Vision in Forestry Nurseries
blurb: Transforming silviculture through automated seedling QC. How AI monitors viability and stress in the nursery to ensure higher survival rates, better timber quality, and more resilient reforestation at scale.
takeaway: How AI monitors seedling viability and stress for higher survival rates and more resilient reforestation.
bestFor: Forestry and nursery sector, research institutes
